page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4.large belongs to the Local SSDs family and is engineered to serve applications that require dedicated compute alongside immediate, high-throughput storage access. The instance is built upon the x86_64 architecture running under the KVM hypervisor. Hardware compute resources consist of 2 dedicated vCPUs from the Intel Xeon 8369B series, running at a clock frequency of 2.7 GHz. System memory totals 16 GB, resulting in an 8.0 GB memory-to-core ratio that comfortably supports memory-intensive operational structures alongside disk-heavy operations.

Storage is a core distinguishing element of the ecs.i4.large configuration, which includes a bundled 479 GB local SSD. Unlike instances that rely entirely on network-attached block devices, the integrated solid-state disk eliminates network traversal for primary disk operations, facilitating lower I/O latencies and high sequential throughput. Networking is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps. The server operates purely on central processor compute, incorporating zero physical or virtual GPUs and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From an efficiency perspective, the combination of dedicated compute cores, 8 GB of RAM per vCPU, and direct-attached SSD capacity delivers a balanced environment for cost-conscious deployments requiring predictable local storage. The fixed local storage capacity presents a deliberate tradeoff: while it minimizes latency for persistent local datasets, instance storage is tied to the physical host lifecycle, requiring replication strategies for high availability. Given this hardware balance, the ecs.i4.large instance fits workloads such as relational databases, NoSQL datastores, Elasticsearch nodes, and local cache layers that benefit from dedicated resources and localized storage.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4.large is a storage-optimized instance tailored for input-output demanding workloads. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, it is powered by two dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B vCPUs operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The system includes 16 GB of memory, establishing a generous allocation of 8 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage capabilities are anchored by an integrated 479 GB local SSD, providing rapid access to data without reliance on external network-attached volumes. Networking features a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps, while graphics processing units are absent. The pairing of ample memory capacity with direct-attached solid-state drive space yields strong efficiency for applications constrained by drive access speeds. This configuration is particularly suited for transactional databases, distributed storage nodes, memory-heavy search indices, and low-latency cache systems.
